verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform with a developer ecosystem, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a REST API, type-safe SDKs, an MCP server, skill files and a Claude Code plugin, but no first-party Vanta command-line tool. Those are adjacent building blocks or different features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
